decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program fits the firm's core mental-health capabilities, extends existing services with relatively low strategic risk, and its dedicated web page suggests committed rollout and demand.

The carpentry workshop supports the firm's disability and practical-therapy mission, uses its stated production know-how, and a standalone page indicates it is a meaningful part of the expanded offer.

Outpatient sociotherapy is very close to the established support portfolio and matches the firm's person-centered, flexible care model, so it is sensible to continue building it despite modest web prominence.
Counseling for senior living directly serves the core eldercare market and its placement on the home page signals strategic importance and likely positive early traction.

The retail shop complements the sheltered-workshop model by creating participation and sales opportunities, and even with limited web emphasis it fits the firm's social and operational logic well enough to retain.
